cases.input: An ERP cost-centre code changes while finance accountability and posting semantics are unchanged.
cases.expect: Centre identity and CentreVersion remain; a dated non-identifying AliasBinding changes.

cases.input: Ledger scope and accountable position change during reorganization.
cases.expect: A successor CentreVersion becomes effective; historical postings remain pinned to the prior version.

cases.input: An associated organizational unit moves while finance accountability is unchanged.
cases.expect: No centre identity or version is minted merely from the organization move.

cases.input: One centre splits into two successors.
cases.expect: Lineage records weights or an explicit reconciliation rule and preserves the predecessor for historical resolution.

cases.input: Two sources fund one project, then the organization and budget are revised.
cases.expect: Postings retain the effective CentreVersion; V1, V2, forecast, commitments and actuals stay distinct; source authority is counted once.

cases.input: Allocations from one source exceed its authorized released amount for the period.
cases.expect: The Budget Responsibility profile rejects the allocation set.

cases.input: Budget V2 treats V1 source authorization as newly available without an amended source authorization.
cases.expect: The profile rejects the successor revision as duplicate availability.

cases.input: A source amount or remainder rule is unknown and the implementation treats it as zero or unrestricted.
A reorganization rewrites prior journal attribution from CentreVersion v1 to v2.
cases.expect: Validation rejects the rewrite and preserves the original pin.

cases.input: Two active CentreVersions overlap for one centre.
One ERP code resolves to two centres in the same code system and instant.
Dated memberships create A→B→A in one hierarchy.
cases.expect: Validation rejects the cycle without minting descendant versions.

cases.input: Carry-in exceeds the prior period's reconciled carryable residual for the same source.
cases.expect: Validation rejects the unbounded availability inlet.

cases.input: A journal line references a closed centre or lacks an effective permit.
cases.expect: Posting fails closed; prior postings remain resolvable.

cases.input: Two budgets claim the same source draw while no authoritative draw register is allocated.
An accounting correction reverses an old posting and posts a replacement after a centre change.
cases.expect: The original keeps its old CentreVersion; linked reversal and replacement are appended with their own effective pins.
